caveats: Parallel times assume perfect destination load balance and no CPU oversubscription.
The measured JAX CPU process used a 12-logical-CPU Apple host; server thread scaling remains to be measured on the target machine.
JAX device arrays are conservatively treated as replicated per worker.
Fork copy-on-write or memory mapping may share host assignment arrays but is not credited in the safe estimate.
Prediction reduction and gradient scatter communication are excluded but small relative to graph traversal.
